fields.description: Issue features editorials and local commentary on whether Miami will have horse racing in the coming winter season (including discussion of Hialeah and the Miami Jockey Club), the city’s tourist-season strategy and entertainment offerings, and enforcement actions against gambling. Additional pieces address the Miami Chamber of Commerce’s financial difficulties and staff reductions, police training and examinations, one-way versus two-way street traffic patterns, double punishment for drunk driving, harbor development needs, and a plan in Coral Gables to support new buildings for the University of Miami. Includes society columns, advertisements, and entertainment listings.
